mentions.name: lexaway
mentions.description: A free and open-source language learning app (iOS) built around word-prediction exercises, the way LLMs learned language. It draws on Tatoeba, an online sentence-pairing dataset, and is positioned as an alternative to Duolingo.
mentions.problem: Offers a free, open-source alternative to Duolingo ("the green bird"), which the author dislikes.
mentions.source_excerpt: A language learning app called lexaway. Premise is people can learn like LLMs learned - word prediction. I use tatoeba, an online sentence pairing thing, and it's nice well it's worked for me. I hate the green bird fyi so it's free and open source.

evidence.value: A language learning app called lexaway. Premise is people can learn like LLMs learned - word prediction. I use tatoeba, an online sentence pairing thing, and it's nice well it's worked for me. I hate the green bird fyi so it's free and open source.

mentions.name: Lexaway
mentions.description: A free and open source language learning app presented as a pixel-art game, currently supporting 6 languages. It works fully offline and requires no accounts or signup.
mentions.problem: Mainstream language learning apps like Duolingo have drifted away from what language learning should be.
mentions.source_excerpt: A free and open source language learning app in the form of a pixel-art game - it currently supports 6 languages. It's something I feel Duolingo should've been but I've seen them drift further and further from the point. The app is fully offline and there's no accounts or signup
